purpose: Does nominal anchor replay transfer small material perturbation response to the already-used development depths -1 and+1?
fixed: Known449-pixel support at each depth;source0,same physical solver and scalar density scaling;central a=.5. Freeze original width8 and original-joint-loss R2 final500,not lowfreq winner selection.
baseline: Physical nominal-geometry secant (F(.7,0)-F(.3,0))/.4,constant across depth;uses existing nominal training anchors only. Also retain no-change response as zero baseline.
metrics: Central directional finite differences in receivers(primary) and field(secondary);both epsilons;relativeL2,amplitude ratio,cosine;complete vs scatter point prediction separately.
gates: Physical finite-difference stabilization between epsilons <=2% relative,else inconclusive. Existing derivative screen relativeL2<=20%,cosine>=.9 on both depths and both epsilons;network FD stabilization<=2%. Simple baseline remains explicit.
interpretation: No exact local Jacobian or networkAD claim;this is converged central finite-difference evidence along one known-support direction. Not unseen geometry or independent test;only perturbed material labels newly generated.

outcomes.pass: Preregister fixed-budget known-support single-parameter physical inversion comparison against same simple initializer,then include total offline/online cost. No blind claim.
outcomes.fail: Local material response remains bottleneck;compare simple depth/material separable approximation before derivative supervision or architecture change.
outcomes.reference_unstable: Fix physical finite-difference precision first,do not train to unreliable labels.
